project_type: TypeScript / Next.js 15 (App Router) app: preflight testing + runtime policy layer for agentic commerce. The report/UI is the product; a wrong number is the whole failure.
language: TypeScript (ESM, type: module). React 19 for UI.
build_system: npm. Next.js build. tsx for demo scripts. vitest for tests.
test_framework: vitest (vitest --run). Synthetic Scenario fixtures fed to runSuite() and asserted on output. DB tests gated behind `process.env.DATABASE_URL ? describe : describe.skip`.
build_command: rm -rf .next && npm run build (must Compile successfully)
test_command: npm test  (vitest --run). Without DB: 578 passed / 4 skipped. With DATABASE_URL set: 582 passed / 0 skipped.
verification_instructions: 1) npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit) clean. 2) npm test all green. 3) rm -rf .next && npm run build compiles. 4) LLM_ADAPTER=scripted PAYMENT_ADAPTER=fake npm run demo:preflight MUST show vulnerable 8 passed / 10 safely-rejected / 2 escalated / 5 unsafe / 0 money-critical escapes improving to fixed 11 / 13 / 1 / 0 / 0, with 12/12 policy rules exercised in both. 5) Every bug fix ships a test that FAILS when the fix is reverted (prove revert-fails / restore-passes). 6) Stress-test both merchants over real HTTP SSE routes, all 9 dashboard pages, demo scripts, audit hash chain, concurrency.
snapshot_or_generated_files: No snapshot dir. `.next/` build output is generated and must be removed with `rm -rf .next` after deleting/renaming any route or typecheck fails on stale .next/types artefacts.
setup_instructions: PATH: export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH" at the start of EVERY bash call. Node v22.23.2. Optional Postgres: dnf install -y postgresql16-server postgresql16; bash scripts/dev-db.sh up; export DATABASE_URL="postgres://postgres:password@/agentproof?host=/var/lib/pgsql/agentproof-data". Server test pattern (single bash call, background server does NOT survive between calls): ./node_modules/.bin/next start -p PORT > /tmp/s.log 2>&1 & S=$!; trap "kill $S 2>/dev/null" EXIT; wait-for-ready loop with curl; then curl endpoint in same call.
environment_constraints: Fresh PID namespace per execute_bash: background servers do NOT survive between calls; /tmp is per-command tmpfs. Run server + probe in SAME bash call. gh pr/issue/run list FAIL (GH_HOST); orchestrator handles push/PR/merge. Do NOT git push or open PRs. Use str_replace/edit tools for source edits, never python string-replace (a silent no-match once shipped a no-op fix). Re-read region after every edit to confirm it landed.
contribution_requirements: Every bug fix must ship with a test that fails when the fix is reverted (prove it bites). Keep suite green between fixes so regressions are attributable. Money is integer minor units (Minor), formatted with formatMinor; never introduce float math on money. HamperHub is a frozen invariant: demo:preflight numbers 8/10/2/5 -> 11/13/1/0 with 12/12 both must be byte-for-byte unchanged.
key_patterns: JourneyResult (src/lib/runner/run.ts) has violations, escalations, firedInvariants, moneyAtRiskMinor, disposition, inconclusiveReason ('target_withheld'|'fault_never_fired'|'agent_stopped'|null), exercisedInvariants, withheldInvariants. Violation (src/lib/policy/violations.ts) carries invariantId, intentId, quoteId, moneyAtRiskMinor, content-derived id. SuiteResult has moneyAtRiskMinor, moneyPreventedMinor, moneyNotPreventedMinor, decidedJourneys, readiness, byModel. The inconclusive footnote is computed centrally by describeInconclusive(inconclusiveBreakdown(journeys)) in src/lib/report/inconclusive.ts; UI pages (page.tsx, MerchantConsole.tsx, PreflightConsole.tsx) and SSE routes (api/preflight/route.ts, api/merchants/run/route.ts) all render that returned string, so adding causes there propagates automatically. Interference machinery: src/lib/runner/interference.ts InterferingToolCaller exposes applied(), failureReason() (non-null exactly when fault was attempted but merchant refused), appliedEffect().
relevant_files: src/lib/runner/run.ts (Bug 1 per-journey money sum ~line 631 & suite aggregation ~line 880; Bug 3 InconclusiveReason enum ~line 27 & inconclusiveReason computation ~line 481; note builder ~line 590)
src/lib/scenarios/regression.ts (Bug 2 contestedProduct() ~line 537, used at reg-07 ~line 297 and reg-08 ~line 337)
src/lib/runner/interference.ts (failureReason distinguishes (a) trigger not reached from (b) merchant refused)
tests/honest-reporting.test.ts (pattern: synthetic Scenario -> runSuite -> assert; inconclusive cause tests ~line 179-238; money split tests ~line 287-312)
src/app/api/preflight/route.ts, src/app/api/merchants/run/route.ts (SSE routes computing note server-side)
directory_structure: src/lib/runner (run.ts orchestrates journeys+suite; interference.ts; concurrent.ts). src/lib/scenarios (regression.ts fixed suite + live goals; generate.ts AI). src/lib/report (inconclusive.ts footnote). src/lib/policy/invariants (12 INV-*). src/lib/agent (scripted/openai/anthropic buyer). src/lib/merchant (adapter/source for Nordwell mapping). src/lib/db (Postgres persistence). src/app (Next pages + api SSE routes). src/scripts (demo:* entry points). tests/*.test.ts vitest suites.
